title: Chesapeake Bay Bridge Tunnel Virgina Beach Drone Phantom 3 & OSMO
description:
Chesapeake Bay Bridge Tunnel Virgina Beach Drone

With a military base and airport nearby their wasn't a ton of drone friendly places so I pieced together what I shot

Colors, Saturation and Temperature are off I'm still a beginner with video but I enjoy it as a hobby

Shot with DJI Phantom 3 Professional and DJI OSMO 

Background Music is from user @itsbloc 
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCuJqF7m1r1SpEBBYj087Ltw
